## Looking for AI products worthy of children : know any?

I believe that when founders meet the children they are building for and their parents, everyone wins.

I believe that when an investor hears a pitch, but mostly sees kids interacting with that product, everyone wins.

Last June 20 at VivaTech, nine companies showcased the latest version of their product to hundreds of families throughout the day. These founders have been working incredibly hard to build products worthy of our children. Setting up the space in no time was epic (!) yet some got incredibly creative.

Last June 20 at VivaTech, Children played. Parents asked. Founders engaged.

At noon, they got the chance to pitch their vision to two of Europe’s most recognised investors, child safety experts and France’s largest tech media:
